Club information days, coaching nights, Q&A, group coaching sessions and more

LEARN MORE

CLUB INFORMATION DAYS

At Cigala Cycling we offer club information days, coaching nights with presentations and Q&A, group coaching sessions.
Those events are led by Founder & Head Coach Matteo Cigala for cycling clubs. In the case of triathlon clubs, the events are led by both Matteo Cigala and Michael Black (Triathlon Coach at Cigala Cycling).

During these information days or coaching nights, we provide valuable information for cyclists and triathletes. Information about training, periodisation, nutrition, common mistakes to avoid and much more.

These sessions can be held all over Ireland. Drop us a line below to organise and get a quote.

We will be glad to hear from to organise a club talk
